blob.description: Foreign key to blobs.contentKey; a markdown blob only

lineCount.description: Lines in the decoded text, split on "\n" alone: a CRLF file counts its CRs into the lines, not as separators

h1.description: The rest of the first line that starts with "#" and a space or tab, raw (untrimmed; a CRLF file keeps its CR), anywhere in the text — frontmatter and code blocks included — or null when there is none

frontmatterFence.description: Where the frontmatter fences are, by the skill frontmatter fence rule (a leading BOM dropped, CRLF, lone CR and LF each a line ending, the first line "---" then optional spaces or tabs, the block closed by the next such line): "none" with no opening fence, "unclosed" with no closing one, "closed" with both. Kept whether or not the record is held

matchCount.description: How many matches the record has; when held, how many skill_text_matches rows the blob has, and the reader refuses a blob whose rows do not add up to it

held.description: Whether the store keeps the record: false when it is past its bound (as many matches as the default outputRows, as many JSON bytes as the default outputBytes), and the blob then has no skill_text_matches rows and the skills lane scans the text itself

projection-skill-text-facts.description: A row of the blob-keyed `skill_text_facts` table
